title: Concentration of level-one Fourier weight
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\\{ -1,1 \\}$. If the sum of the squares of its level-one Fourier coefficients is $1$, then there is a coordinate $i$ whose Fourier coefficient has square $1$, and every other level-one Fourier coefficient is zero.
hypotheses_covered: The total Fourier weight at level one equals $1$
